title: The Paper Lantern
author: Freya Montrose
blurb: Vesper Villalobos, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
